**2. Append one item per Ranked-list item** under a new section, in the schema's exact fields. The content will be:

```markdown
## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06

- [ ] 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock (lock-closures O2). Run Stage 1's
      closure-response curve (specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md: under 2%
      of days below 3.1 m, about 60% at 3.8 m) against the river-level forecast
      each day.
      Size: small. One model run a day; Stage 1's fit took 22 min on a laptop.
      Done when: each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook built from the
      river-level forecast.
- [ ] Per-lock closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled (lock-closures O3).
      Stage 1 found the four longest-record locks show close to the same curve.
      Size: about 14 times Stage 1's data (1.8 GB, 11 years of daily gauge
      readings).
      Done when: separate pooled closure curves exist for all 14 locks.
- [ ] Closure-history map for boat operators (lock-closures O4).
      Size: about a day of work; one static map page.
      Done when: boat operators can view a map of each lock's closure history.
```

**3. Edit `specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md`.** Replace the body of `## Ranked list — Track A` with:

Track A stopped 2026-11-06: the Stage 1 curve answers what was needed.
O2, O3 and O4 parked to specs/deferred_items.md
